units.text: Supporting Information Title: Reduced herbicides terbuthylazine, ametryn and atrazine residues and toxicology to maize and environment through salicylic acid ** The authors made equal contribution to the study
.The spiked recoveries of ametryn (AME), atrazine (ATZ) and terbuthylazine (TBA) in soil, shoot and root. Values are means ±SD (n=3). Recovery Figure S1.

The extracted ion chromatograms of metabolites and conjugates of ametryn (AME) in maize (A, B, C, D). MS 2 spectra of AME metabolites. The ion MS/MS spectra were obtained from (A) m/z 211 precursor ion, (B) m/z 213 precursor ion, (C) m/z 185 precursor ion, (D) m/z 199 precursor ion, (E) m/z 241 precursor ion, (F) m/z 243 precursor ion, precursor ion of degradation products. MS 2 spectra of AME-conjugates. The ion MS/MS spectra of conjugates were obtained from (A) m/z 405 precursor ion, (B) m/z 377 precursor ion, (C) m/z 414 precursor ion, (D) m/z 300 precursor ion, (E) m/z 387 precursor ion, (F) m/z 429 precursor ion, (G) m/z 317 precursor ion, (H) m/z 516 precursor ion, (I) m/z 486 precursor ion.
